objective: Capture trustworthy CPU/RAM/task/resource and bounded-soak evidence for the integrated semantic-execution stack without touching PADataset GPUs, widening authority, or conflating measurement with performance claims.
invariant: Resource observation is read-only evidence. It must not alter executor selection, authority, task state, browser behavior, candidate history, or system services except through separately reviewed test harnesses.

phases.name: resource observer and accounting canary
phases.implementation_goal: Add a deterministic machine-readable observer for the Linux semantic backend/harness and durable task state, with unit tests proving observation-only behavior.
required_metrics: process CPU user/system deltas for the managed E3 process tree
RSS and peak RSS; PSS when available without privilege
operator action counts by durable state
executor session counts by durable state and generation
ReasoningProcess counts by durable state and generation
readyManualCycles and sentUnconfirmed/awaiting-ack counts where exposed
PostgreSQL-backed durable graph version and expected object counts
sampling interval/gap count so missing telemetry is visible
constraints: No GPU/NVIDIA telemetry and no PADataset access.
No root/helper authority required for measurement.
Do not introduce psutil or another dependency unless justified; prefer stable platform/runtime primitives already present.
acceptance: same workload state with observer enabled vs disabled is semantically identical
metrics serialize deterministically to a versioned JSON report
unknown/unavailable metrics are explicit rather than fabricated

phases.name: bounded no-model soak
phases.implementation_goal: Run the integrated scheduler/runtime through repeated deterministic/fake-worker cycles with the E3 observer attached, including normal cleanup and at least one generation-recovery cycle.

bounds.duration_or_cycles: Choose a bounded duration/cycle count from existing validated soak conventions; record the exact chosen bound in the review before execution.

required_evidence: no unexplained monotonic growth in threads, FDs, managed child processes, sessions, actions, or unresolved processes
all intentionally created stale generations remain fenced
all cycles reach expected terminal/cleanup states
sampling gaps and failed observations are counted

phases.name: bounded live resource/soak evidence
phases.implementation_goal: Instrument a representative accepted Research-Iterate live mission, preferably the E2 recovery topology because it exercises the hardest validated path, and capture the same resource/accounting evidence through cleanup.
required_evidence: live CPU/RAM/task/resource report bound to exact source/authority/candidate heads
phase timings for decomposition, exact-source read, generation-0 service/fence, PostgreSQL rehydration, replacement generation, Workspace Shell probe, fan-in, synthesis, rollback
final durable task/action/session counts consistent with mission completion
Windows Operator offline and Linux private-route rollback after completion
no automatic typing/submission, browser scraping, paid API fallback, or authority widening

after_e3: E4 calibrated economics comparison versus all-strong/frontier control.
E5 authoritative target-machine UX-09 performance benchmark.
E6 exact SHA/blob/route provenance, authority, rollback and unresolved-violation audit.
E7 reconcile every November acceptance-matrix requirement to PASS or explicit promotion blocker.
E8 integrated PROMOTE_V0 / HOLD / REVISE decision.
